'''Soz juice''' was a salinated juice served during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The juice could be used as an ingredient in [[braised scyk belly]]<ref name="Scyk" /> and [[jellied glowshroom stew]].<ref name="Jellied" />
